mentions.name: Daily mystery bird guessing game
mentions.description: A daily web game where players try to guess a mystery bird by asking preselected questions about traits like color and size to whittle down the possibilities, drawing from birds reported on eBird in their county over the last two weeks; currently set up for California.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a game where you try to guess a daily mystery bird.

http://jerm.cool/bird/

It pulls a list of birds reported on eBird in your county in the last 2 weeks and you ask preselected questions like the the color or size to whittle down the possibilities.
